items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, according to Rust, the trumpets in the band when you were there...

ctx.x: But I don't know if he was there when I went in the band or not. Because I worked with Gus in it looked like every band I ever worked in! He was one that got around, too.
Well, according to Rust, the trumpets in the band when you were there, or at least on the recordings...
See, now, you got a band name down here. You've got Gene Aikins, trumpet.
